scientific_integrity: Exact finite integer enumerations of all regular seven-vertex tournaments and complete Walsh transforms, with independent full-cube and affine-quotient implementations. No claim of independent review or general theorem for larger tournaments.
scientific_limitations: Seven labelled vertices only. Standard reversal and matching-character symmetries explain some zeros. Complete historical novelty is not independently established; implicit older coefficient specializations remain possible.
title: Complete Walsh recovery and sharp projection constant for regular seven-vertex tournaments
